text: __NOTOC__ Ranaris is a night elf located in El'dranil Shallows in Azsuna. He betrayed and abandoned Celea and her partner during the fallout of the Great Sundering, which had them killed.
__NOTOC__ Ranger General Feleor is a night elf located at Black Rook Hold. She was risen and found alongside General Tel'arn. Like him, she was given eternal rest by the request of Rensar Greathoof.
Rangari Elekks are elekks of the Rangari located in Gorgrond.
Rangari Sharpshooters are draenei located in . They also participated in the attack on Grommashar in , and they are also seen at the Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.

Rancora is a fel-infused Burning Legion world. It is a landscape of festering pools and skittering death, and many skittering demons originate from it. Portal Keeper Hasabel opens a portal to Rancora during her encounter in Antorus, the Burning Throne, summoning the aranasi Lady Dacidion and Feltouched Skitterer spider demons.
Ramik Slamwrench was a goblin battlemaster located in the Underbelly below Dalaran.
Rangalag is a sea giant located in the Ruins of Vashj'ir in Shimmering Expanse, being conscripted by the Zithreenai naga. He is kept in chains.
The Ramkahen Prisoner is a tol'vir located in the Vir'naal River Delta in Uldum. He has been captured by the Neferset tribe.
Ramkahen Laborers are tol'vir located in the Akhenet Fields in Uldum. They are summoned by the Horn of Ramkahen during Ancient Weapons. They are also present during the Assault in Uldum.
Ramkahen Infantries are tol'vir located in Uldum. They are also present during the Assault in Uldum.
Ramkahen Guardians are max-level tol'vir guards located in Ramkahen in Uldum. Some are found within the Vision of the Twisting Sands.
Ramkahen Field Workers are tol'vir located in Uldum. They are also present during the Assault in Uldum.
Ramkahen Citizens are tol'vir located in Ramkahen in Uldum. Some appear in the Vision of the Twisting Sands.
Rampaging Riverbeast was a riverbeast located in Overlook Ruins in Gorgrond. It was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.

__NOTOC__ Rampaging Owlbeasts are wildkin located in south-eastern Hillsbrad Foothills. By the time of the Fourth War, the owlbeasts seem to have moved to the opposite side of Thoradin's Wall, into the Arathi Highlands. They are also seen during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Ranger's Chainmail is a quest reward from Warning Fairbreeze Village.
Raluun appears as the memory of a draenei child in the Forge of Aeons.

Ranvin is an ice troll of the Winterfang tribe. He is one of Shakor's brothers, and he hates his cousin Kril'fon. He wanted to gather his tribesmen and correct the mistake Shakor did by letting the dangerous Kril let go.
Rampaging Squallhunters are storm drakes located in Stormheim.
__NOTOC__ Ranja is a bear located in the Stagheart Cliffs in Tiragarde Sound.
Rampaging Grunts are orcs located in Brennadam Square in Stormsong Valley.
Ranah's Watering Can is provided as an objective for Wither Without Water.
Rangari Scouts are draenei located in , Gorgrond, Frostfire Ridge, and Tanaan Jungle.
__NOTOC__ Ranah is a vulpera repair vendor and quest giver located at the Withering Gulch in Vol'dun. She is apparently trying to restore the gulch's ruined fields by repairing the nearby fountains.
__NOTOC__ Rana the Cutta is a Zandalari troll located at the Terrace of Crafters in Dazar'alor.
Rangari Sunon is a draenei ghost. He spawns on the balcony east of Exarch's Refuge in Talador.

Ranzul Sonja is a Zandalari troll located in the Drunken Drummer in Dazar'alor. During Talanji's coronation, riots erupted in the Zocalo, and Ranzul was defending a Zocalo Shopper and Zuaba Sonja against a Rioting Speaker.
Ranishu Runt is sold by Jenoh in Vol'dun and Dodger in Boralus for 250 Polished Pet Charm.

Ranah's Mount is, as the name suggests, the hyena mount of Ranah, located at the Withering Gulch in Vol'dun. After completion of The Source of the Problem, Ranah mounts the hyena, rides off a short distance, and despawns.

.]] Randall Redmond is an employee of the Ashvane Trading Company initially encountered at Randall's Refuge in Vol'dun. He has recently been trying to make contact with the Zandalari exiles at the Scorched Sands Outpost. When encountered by the adventurer, he claims that when he took the job, he was not informed that the Trading Company's expedition to Vol'dun was a one-way trip. He offers to give the champion the code to Captain Hartford's lockbox if they help him escape from Vol'dun. First, he sends the adventurer to kill the other members of his expedition party at the Ashvane Encampment and gather some supplies he'll need when he uses his boat to travel back to Boralus. __NOTOC__ Randall's Refuge is a small camp belonging to Randall Redmond, nestled under a cliff just north of Redrock Harbor in southern Vol'dun. It consists only of a single tent, a campfire, and a boat which Redmond (falsely) claims he'll use to travel to Boralus after deserting the Ashvane Trading Company.
Ranishu Stomachs drop from Ranishu Nibblers and Ranishu Ravagers in Vol'dun.

Ranishu Nibblers are ranishu located around the Bone Pit and the southern outskirts of the Court of Zak'rajan in Vol'dun. Smaller than the Ranishu Ravagers, they often travel around the pit in groups.
Ranishu Ravagers are ranishu located around the Bone Pit and the southern outskirts of the Court of Zak'rajan in Vol'dun. Unlike the smaller Ranishu Nibblers, they are usually found alone.
Ramon Tikaram is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Ranishu Servants are ranishu that can be summoned by King Rakataka in Bonetrail Gulch in Vol'dun while the world quest Feeding Frenzy (quest) is available.
__NOTOC__ Ranishu Grubs are ranishu larvae found swarming around the three dead Brutosaurs in the Eastern Dunes in Vol'dun while the world quest Ranishu Feeding Frenzy is available.
__NOTOC__ Ranger Paalu is a deceased draenei located in Zuldazar.
Ranishu Gorgers are ranishu located in Redrock Mesa in Vol'dun.

Rallying War Banner is a toy that has a chance to drop from 7th Legion Supplies or Honorbound Supplies. Depending on the faction, using it summons an Alliance Banner and Horde Banner and causes the player to shout "For the Alliance!" or "For the Horde!".
Rangyu the Mender is a pandaren located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
__NOTOC__ Rampant Fire Elementals are fire elementals located at Direforge Hill in the Wetlands.
Ranishu Swarmers are ranishu found in various locations in Vol'dun, including Bonetrail Gulch as well as Redrock Mesa and Redrock Cavern.
__NOTOC__ Rampaging Gatecrashers are abominations located in Mariner's Row in Boralus during Faction Assaults.
The Ranishu Scorcher is a ranishu located inside a small cave in Bonetrail Gulch in Vol'dun, feasting on a dead Bonepicker Hyena alongside a Ranishu Devourer.
Ranishu Devourers are ranishu located in Bonetrail Gulch in Vol'dun.
Ranishu Burrowers are ranishu that emerge from the corpse of the Bloated Krolusk at the Bone Pit in Vol'dun.
Ranger's Notched Dirk is a quest reward from The Ring of Mmmrrrggglll.
The Ranja-Hide Bracers drop from Ranja at the Stagheart Cliffs in Tiragarde Sound.
Ranald Flamehair is a vrykul located in Beryl Meadow in Stormsong Valley, having been killed by Severus the Outcast.
Raoul's Barrelhook Bracers drop from the Council o' Captains encounter in Freehold.
Rampaging Berserkers are orcs and Forsaken located in Vol'dun during Faction Assaults.
Rapacious Fathomjaws are threshadons located at Backwater Beach in Zuldazar.
Rana's 'Ancient Artifact drops from Bonescreamer in Zuldazar.
Ramkahen Lancers are tol'vir War Campaign troop units, unlocked by Troop Requisition: Ramkahen Lancer.
Rangari Skirmishers are draenei located at Iron Docks in Gorgrond.
Rampaging Clefthooves are clefthooves located in Iron Docks.
The Rank Insignia: Acquisitionist is sold by Ve'nari for 1575x Stygia at her refuge in the Maw for players with an Cordial or higher standing with her.
Rampaging Hulks are wicker beasts located in Drustvar during Faction Assaults.
Rampaging Elementals rea Azerite elementals located in Drustvar during Faction Assaults.
Ram's Belly is a transport ship located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .
Ramparts Racer is a quest achievement earned by winning the Revendreth world quest It's Race Day in the Ramparts! 10 times.
Rapid Concealment was a tier 1 talent in the Subtlety rogue tree. Maxing it required a total of 5 points in Subtlety.
Random Memory Access is a potential daily quest at Keeper's Respite in Korthia.
Rampaging Mauler is a rare drop from Konthrogz the Obliterator, a rare-elite worldeater devourer that spawns upon the completion of a handful of Conquering Korthia-required vignettes.
Rampaging Giant's Chestplate is dropped by Sludgefist in Castle Nathria.
__NOTOC__ Rana, previously Al'rana, is a broker located in Haven in Zereth Mortis. She goes with Al'dalil to Slumbering Vault to ensure it is safe from Cartel Xy.
The Rangari Corral can be built in Telaari Station in . Its counterpart is the Telaari Tankworks
Ransacked Ring drops from the following Springtail virmen in the Valley of the Four Winds: *Springtail Warren-Mother *Springtail Littlewhisker *Springtail Trapper *Springtail Burrower
Rambunctious Tideskippers are dolphins swimming back and forth near the Alliance and Horde landing at the Wild Coast in the Waking Shores.

Ranger Otyuk is a centaur located on the river shore just south of Timberstep Outpost in the Ohn'ahran Plains. His bakar, Pesca, has been dognapped by the Mudfin tribe, but returns to Otyuk's side after Return to Roscha.

Ranger Bolor is a centaur roaming the southern outskirts of Timberstep Outpost in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Her bakar, Batu, was killed by the Mudfin tribe. After completion of Return to Roscha, players can inform Bolor of Batu's death. __NOTOC__
Ramloaf is sold by innkeepers and food vendors throughout the Dragon Isles.
Ranpiata is a tuskarr located with Hudson at Hudson's Rock in the Azure Span.
Rampaging Forest Giants are stone giants located in the Azure Span.
Ranger Jargal is a centaur located in Cloverwood Hollow in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Random Scribblings are found in random rooms of the Zskera Vaults in Forbidden Reach. Cataloger Wulferd is looking for three of them in Authentic Authorization.
Rampaging Waters are water elementals located in the Waking Shores.
Rampaging Winds are air elementals located in the Waking Shores.
Random Samples are oozelings located in the Zskera Vault: Ur in the Forbidden Reach.
Rampaging Downpours are water elementals located at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.
Rampaging Mammoths are magmammoths located at the Battlefield Ruins in Zaralek Cavern.
Ramping Amplitude Gigavolt Engine drops from High Tinker Mekkatorque in Battle of Dazar'alor.

Rats are common rodents found all over Azeroth, Outland and .

Rare (sometimes called superior) is the level of item quality in between and . * The names of Rare quality items will appear in blue. * Rare quality items are sometimes referred to as "Blues." * Equippable items of Rare quality almost always have one or more attribute bonuses, and some have procs. * Depending on the class and spec the item is aimed at, Rare gear will have 2 or 3 primary stat bonuses (3 usually including Spirit for healer specs), with one or two secondary stat bonuses (one usually if the gear has Spirit on it). * Most equippable items at Rare quality and above can be disenchanted by characters with the Enchanting profession. * Some ingredient items are of Rare quality, includ

Ras Frostwhisper was an elite lich of the Scourge and overseer of everything that happened in Scholomance. He watched over and taught all those who rose to the position of 'Dark Master'. He was a lieutenant and favored pupil of Kel'Thuzad.

The ravasaurs are large, raptor-like dinosaurs. The ones in Un'Goro are highly intelligent, volatile, and have a sense or code of conduct. Lar'korwi is the most dangerous. In Taur-ahe, its name means "Sharp Claw," but that does not do him justice. The ravasaurs of Zandalar are more distinct from raptors than the Un'Goro breed are, with crests of feathers on their heads and tails. Ravasaurs may be common throughout other lands than just Un'Goro, as they are common troll companions alongside raptors. The females produce an awful smell from a gland in their heads that allow males to know they are ready to breed. The venomhide ravasaurs are extremely deadly, with poisonous blood, poisonous spit

__NOTOC__ The Ravaged Caravan is a ruined Venture Company camp on the northeastern shore of Stonebull Lake. The caravan is what's left of a conflict between the tauren and the Venture Co. after the tauren saw them traveling throughout Mulgore. The caravan's initial goal was to deliver more supplies to Supervisor Fizsprocket's mining endeavor. It now sits on a mound, spewing out black smoke. The remaining company aggressively defends the smoldering remains of their precious cargo.
Ratchet Bruisers are goblins located in Ratchet in Northern Barrens. During the Legion Invasions, they fought against the demons. Some of them were mind-controlled by the enemy.

Rattlegore is a level 43 elite bone golem mini-boss in Scholomance. He is directly under the Great Ossuary (Plagued Hatchling room) near Jandice Barov's dungeon (you can enter through the stairs or just fall through the holes in the hatchling room, but that is not recommended).
Rashona Straglash was a level 35 orc quest giver located in Magar's Cloth Goods in the Drag in Orgrimmar.

Raptor Grounds is a tiny valley located in the southern part of the Barrens and west of Northwatch Hold. It is densely populated by the Sunscale raptors, who are odd among their kind, showing an unnatural intelligence and even building their own crude huts and tools. Their attraction to shiny objects and, indeed, anything out of the ordinary has caused them to steal many items from the Horde settlements in the area.

__NOTOC__ Rathorian is a rare felguard found atop Dreadmist Peak in the Northern Barrens. He once guarded the Demon Seed, but now Xelnaz is tasked with that. Rathorian leads the cultists in the area. He is on a 1.5-2.5 hour respawn timer.

Raptor Ridge is located in the eastern Wetlands, just northwest of the dangerous Dragonmaw Gates. The raptors lair here in large numbers, and the ridge also features a cavern where the fierce Razormaw Matriarch watches over her brood. Raptors Ridge is also seen in the north west of the Twilight Highlands map and is the location where adventurers follow Alexstrasza and Deathwing during their battle. Around the time of the war against the Lich King, Rhonin and Iridi arrived here. The mage told the draenei that most of the raptors had moved toward the direction of Menethil Harbor because they sensed what was going on in Grim Batol. After the situation in Grim Batol was dealt with, Rhonin was po
Ravagers are voracious insectoid predators native to Draenor, now Outland. They first arrived on Azeroth aboard the draenei's dimensional fortress, the Exodar.

__NOTOC__ Ravaged Corpses are common zombies found west of Brill, in central Tirisfal Glades. They have infested the area near the old bridge by Cold Hearth Manor, and are becoming a nuisance to Forsaken activities in the area. Deathguard Dillinger is looking for adventurers to beat them back.
Ravak Grimtotem is a tauren serving the Horde in Alterac Valley. He was sent by Magatha Grimtotem to research other races.
Rau Cliffrunner is a tauren quest giver located under Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Before the Cataclysm, he was located in the Post.

__NOTOC__ The Rat Cage is a possible reward from the quests A Warden of the Alliance and A Warden of the Horde during the Children's Week seasonal event. It teaches the players to summon Whiskers the Rat.
Ravandwyr (pronounced "RAH-van-dweer") is a high elf quest giver located at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

Raptor Hunter Tunic is a quest reward from Raptor Mastery (4).
Raptor Punch is a drink that raises intellect temporarily at the cost of stamina. It is only available as a quest reward.
The Raptor Hide Harness can be crafted with Leatherworking (165); taught by Pattern: Raptor Hide Harness.
Raptor Hide Belt is a leather belt with stamina and agility bonuses, suitable for rogues and DPS druids and shamans.
The Ravaged Twilight Camp is located in the Crystal Vale in northwestern Silithus. It is the current home of Highlord Demitrian. A reference is made to it in State of the Cult, Volume 127.
Using the Rat Catcher's Flute with a targetted and within range of the flute enthralls the rat. __NOTOC__
Rathis Tomber is a Forsaken trade goods vendor located at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands.
Ravager Dog is created by Outland Cooking (1); taught by Recipe: Ravager Dog.
Raptor mounts are the racial mounts of the troll race. Most are restricted to the Horde, though a number of neutral raptors have been added through the years.
Rat Cloth Belt drops from Tunnel Rat Surveyors in Loch Modan. During , it was available via Crate of Salvage and Big Crate of Salvage.
Rat Cloth Cloak drops from Kubb in Loch Modan. During , it was available via Crate of Salvage and Big Crate of Salvage. It drops from Grizlak in Loch Modan.
The Raptorbane Armor was a quest reward from Ormer's Revenge (3).
Rathorian's Cape is an item that can be dropped by Rathorian, a rare mob in the Northern Barrens.
Rare Fish - Brownell's Blue Striped Racer is a quest to turn in the rare fish Brownell's Blue Striped Racer which can be caught during the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza.

The Ravager's Bracers are epic plate wrists with a random enchantment that drop from Rokad the Ravager in Karazhan.

Ras Splinterspine was a lich belonging to the Scourge, although his true allegiance lay with the Burning Legion and not the Lich King. During the Scourge civil war, he sided with the dreadlord Balnazzar in opposition to Sylvanas Windrunner. During the siege of Lordaeron he commanded an undead faction within the Dreadlord Insurgents and was presumably killed by the forces of Sylvanas, Varimathras and Garithos.

Rattlebore is a Jormungar brood mother found in the Ice Heart Cavern in the Dragonblight. She was named by an adventurer from the Plaguelands, most likely after Rattlegore.
The Ravaged Crystalline Ice Giant is a dead ice giant located in Ice Heart Cavern in the Dragonblight.
The Raptor Pens is an area within Drak'Tharon Keep that contains the ice trolls raptors that they use as mounts. King Dred can be found within the stables section.
Raptor Claws are located on the shelves in Finklestein's Laboratory at Heb'Valok in Zul'Drak.
The Rare Cache of Winter can be found in Ulduar after defeating Hodir in under 3 minutes.
Rarkag is a level 78 elite wolvar food and drink vendor located at Frenzyheart Hill in Sholazar Basin.
Raptor hatchlings are companions that were added in patch 3.2.0. One is bought, three are rare drops from raptor mobs, and four are 100% drops from rare spawning nests.
A raptoryx is a half-lizard, half-bird creature concept that resembles a pterrordax and would have likely been found on the Lost Isles. They are likely inspired by the archaeopteryx.

While you can defeat many undead with mortal weapons, they seldom stay that way. In this quest chain, you will permanently lay to rest the lich known as Ras Frostwhisper. You must have completed The Ghosts of Caer Darrow quest chain and have the Spectral Essence equipped in order to start this quest chain.
Rash Gloves is a quest reward from Ix'lar the Underlord (quest).
Rasha'krak's Bracers of Binding drop from Rasha'krak in the Searing Gorge.

Raptor Rise is the cliff side just east of the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles. A path which travels through this area leads to the Oomlot Village and Ruins of Vashj'elan. Spiny Raptors are found here.
Rat Pack is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for killing 20 Mine Rats during the Helix Gearbreaker encounter in Deadmines on Heroic difficulty.
The Ravaged Crypt is the first room in the Mana-Tombs instance. Ethereals conduct their work in the crypt, with a subjugated Pandemonius accompanying them.
The raptor army is an unofficial name for a group of raptors from Raptor Ridge led by Rhonin.
Rathrak, the Poisonous Mind drops from Madness of Deathwing in Dragon Soul.

__NOTOC__ Rassharom, Ancient Emperor of Pandaria, was a jinyu emperor of Pandaria in ancient times. A member of the Pearlfin tribe, he ruled all of Pandaria millennia ago, before the enslavement of the jinyu by the mogu. Rassharom's spirit answered the waterspeakers of the Pearlfin tribe in their search for answers, and - along with visions of great heroes coming to their aid - convinced the Pearlfin to join with the Alliance in the war for Pandaria.

__NOTOC__ Ravager Hatchlings are ravagers located on Bloodmyst Isle.

Rattle No More is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Rattlegore without allowing him to gain more than 5 stacks of Rusting in Scholomance on Heroic difficulty.
Ravaged Cadavers are zombies that wander Stratholme. They are likely to spawn Broken Cadavers.
Rations Officer Flexgear is a gnome food & drink vendor located at the Steelspark Station in Tanaris.
Raptorhide Boxing Gloves drop from the Kor'kron mobs found throughout the Northern Barrens.
Rascal-Bot is created with Engineering (600); taught by Schematic: Chief Engineer Jard's Journal.
__NOTOC__ Rattleskew is a human ghost located at the Barnacle on the Timeless Isle. He spawns as the third wave of the Battle of the Barnacle.

Ravaged Iron Horde Belt is a drop from various Iron Horde corpses that can be turned in with 50 Iron Horde Scraps for a Bind to Account transmog belt. Alliance players exchange with in the Dwarven Bunker garrison building. Horde players exchange with in the War Mill garrison building.

Ravager larvae are the first stage of the ravager life cycle. Ravagers hatch as small ravenous larva, but soon disappear into pupae, only to emerge as slender wasps with a swarm mentality and a ferocious sting. Wasps quickly set out to gorge themselves until their wings can no longer support their body weight, after which they undergo a third and final metamorphosis into a vicious four-legged insect.

Rattling Iron Cage is a container that drops one of three mounts. It can drop from any of the champions of required for Hellbane in Tanaan Jungle. Killing all of them will give you four chances each day to get a cage.
Rasthe, Son of Sethe, is a skeletal wind serpent vignette at the Ruins of Kra'nak in Tanaan Jungle. He is being revived by the arakkoa.
The Raptor's Maw is a cave located in the northwestern Zorammarsh in Tanaan Jungle. It is home to The Goreclaw and other Scaleclaw raptors.

Rascal's Treasure Chest Kit allows the player to place (using a target reticule) an Innocent Looking Treasure Chest on the ground. Any player at all may open it. There are two possible outcomes: * the 'trick' - the chest emits a Holy Nova-like visual effect. * the 'treat' - the chest shoots several fireworks of different kinds into the air, which proceed to explode into different patterns.
__NOTOC__ Rasil Fireborne is a blood elf standing behind the counter on the bottom floor of Dalaran's Photonic Playground shop, which he is seemingly the proprietor of.
Ratstallion Harness is looted from Crate of Ratstallion Harnesses.
Ratstallion is an achievement reward from Underbelly Tycoon.
Rattling Dead are vrykul skeletons that spawn in groups to attack Hruthnir and the warrior player during the first stage of Legacy of the Icebreaker.
Rapid Innervation is a Balance druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Solar Stabbing and Twilight Glow traits.

Rauren is an owlcat located at the Feathermane Hunting Grounds in Suramar. She can usually be found singing to a litter of cubs, but if disturbed, she will not forgive the disruptor. The Feathermane became hunted, so the singing owlcat began tempting the surviving Feathermane kittens away.
Ravaged Wristclamp Strap is a quest reward from The King's Path.
Ravaged Supplies are crates found in Scavenger's Edge on the Broken Shore.
Rat King was a felguard who rounded up the rats in the sewer and was going to used them to infect Dalaran. He was killed by the Council of the Black Harvest.

s]] The Rastari are the elite military group of the Zandalari Empire. Brooches are used to denote high ranking members of the Rastari. The Rastari units occupied Mistvine Ledge, Veiled Grotto, and Verdant Hollow until they were taken by the Alliance.
__NOTOC__ Raul the Tenacious is a worgen located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.

The Raptari are a Zandalari order that serves Gonk. They consist mainly of druids, but also include warriors and hunters. Unlike the Darkspear tribe druids, Gonk did not just speak to the Zandalari. Gonk for the Raptari is not just a fragment or piece of him, but physically there, a real voice they can listen to in person. Several members joined the Warpack and accompanied Rastakhan and the loa into Atal'Dazar.
Rare White Tiger Heart is a quest reward from A Favor for Mr. Shackle.
Rastakhan's Eternal Flame Totem is sold by Griftah in Dazar'alor. It summons a Worthless Totem.

Rastari Enforcers are Zandalari troll guards found in Dazar'alor. The ones stationed at Zanchul were corrupted. Some of them are off-duty. They also appear inside of Uldir. They are also present in both versions of the Battle of Dazar'alor.

Raptari Galo'wey is a Zandalari troll located in Dazar'alor. He is present in the Hall of the High Priests during Talanji's coronation.
Raptari Druids are Zandalari trolls located in Dazar'alor and Zuldazar. During Talanji's coronation, one appeared in the Hall of the High Priests.
Raptari Vanguards are Zandalari trolls located in Zuldazar. They ride ravasaurs.
Rastari Guards are Zandalari trolls located in the Mugambala in Zuldazar.

Rastari Honor Guards are Zandalari trolls located in Dazar'alor and Uldir. Several of them guard the entrance of the Hall of the High Priests in Zanchul alongside Rastari Prelates during Wisdom of the Warchief. They were present in the Zocalo and Zanchul in Dazar'alor during Talanji's coronation.

Rastari Scouts are Zandalari trolls located in Dazar'alor. They are mounted on raptors.

To be able to use the Gonk totems, one must first complete Picking a Side and choose the Gonk loa. Choosing Pa'ku and using that loa's totems is required for Paku'ai (achievement).
